projectlens.title: ProjectLens
projectlens.summary: Browser-local change assurance: compare a change pack with its schedule and record the board response.
projectlens.problem: Change packs and schedules drift apart before board meetings. ProjectLens loads both in the browser, surfaces the largest conflicts with source dates, and records the human decision and its conditions.
points: One-click Northstar demo runs on bundled synthetic fixtures — no install, no upload.
Pytest and Playwright suites run in CI and assert the demo's exact outcomes.
The README states boundaries explicitly, including what the tool does not prove.
projectlens.note: Everything on the demo page is synthetic fixture data committed to the repo.

ai-evaluator.title: Output Gate
ai-evaluator.summary: A deterministic regression gate for saved LLM outputs: required and banned phrases, in the browser or CI.
ai-evaluator.imageAlt: Output Gate regression check workbench screenshot
ai-evaluator.problem: Prompt and model changes quietly reintroduce known output failures. Output Gate replays saved outputs against a phrase policy and returns a pass or fail as a CI exit code — no model call, no API key.
points: Runs in the browser or as a composite GitHub Action.
Deterministic: the same inputs always produce the same decision.
Scope is stated plainly — it does not check facts; a fluent fabrication that avoids the banned list still passes.
ai-evaluator.note: Repository and package name: ai-workflow-evaluator. The portfolio name is Output Gate.

meetingproof.title: MeetingProof
meetingproof.summary: Evidence-linked meeting follow-up: draft decisions, actions and questions, approve them yourself before export.
meetingproof.problem: Meeting follow-ups lose the link back to what was said. MeetingProof extracts decisions, actions and questions with exact source lines, and nothing is exported without an explicit human command.
points: One-click safe example loads synthetic notes in the browser — no key, no upload.
A 30-case evaluation fixture ships with the repo; no model-quality numbers are claimed.
CI tests assert the interrupt-before-export gate and exact evidence quotes.
meetingproof.note: Rule-based extraction expects labelled notes; model-backed extraction is optional.

paper-trading.title: Paper Trading Research Engine
paper-trading.summary: Evidence-bundled walk-forward backtesting: reproducible reports, risk controls and honestly labelled synthetic benchmarks.
paper-trading.imageAlt: Paper trading research engine benchmark console screenshot
paper-trading.problem: Backtest results are easy to cherry-pick and hard to reproduce. This engine bundles every report with its provenance, and deliberately publishes only synthetic fixture numbers.
points: Two-command local demo against a committed synthetic fixture — no API keys.
CI runs linting, multi-version tests, CodeQL and a security audit.
The benchmark table is labelled synthetic; real market results are not published without full provenance. Not financial advice.
paper-trading.note: Paper trading only. Nothing here is investment advice or a performance claim.

happening-core.title: Happening
happening-core.summary: A private London-events pipeline: 129 venue source configs, dedupe and a 1,130-test reliability suite over 3,000+ real events. The open-core repo makes its schemas and quality benchmark public.
happening-core.imageAlt: Happening event feed and map interface screenshot
happening-core.problem: Venue listings are scattered across pages with different layouts and reliability. Happening gives each source explicit config, extraction rules, dedupe and scheduled checked runs.
points: One command against committed example data; no third-party runtime dependencies.
CI tests assert the exact benchmark numbers, including the README's example score.
The README lists what is deliberately not here: no live feed, no scraping selectors, no customer data.
happening-core.note: The private Happening platform is paused; this public core is what a stranger can verify.

pyspark.title: PySpark Kafka Streaming
pyspark.summary: Compact PySpark and Kafka examples: DataFrames, JSON event production, and Structured Streaming.
pyspark.problem: Streaming examples are often too big to actually read. This repo keeps three small scripts that run, with a docker-compose Kafka round trip behind one make target.
points: examples/basic_dataframe.py runs with Java and PySpark alone.
make demo runs the Kafka producer and Structured Streaming consumer via Docker.
CI compiles the examples and executes the DataFrame demo via spark-submit.
pyspark.note: The README's status label says it plainly: a compact demo, not a packaged platform.

england.title: Can England Win It
england.summary: An interactive World Cup scenario simulator, archived after the event with an honest postmortem.
england.imageAlt: Can England Win It scenario simulator screenshot
england.problem: Tools built for a single event go stale after it. This app ran 10,000 seeded simulations per scenario, and was archived with a postmortem instead of being left to rot.
points: Seed-deterministic simulation with tests for bounds, monotonicity and uncertainty ranges.
npm test runs in CI before every deploy.
POSTMORTEM.md explains why archiving was more honest than a stale countdown.
england.note: This is a scenario tool, not a forecast or betting product.

quicksupply.title: QuickSupply
quicksupply.summary: A supply-cover workflow for requests, agencies, teacher offers, compliance, and live status.
quicksupply.problem: School cover coordination can become a spreadsheet-and-message chain. QuickSupply shapes the job around request intake, sequential agency assignment, teacher availability, compliance checks, and status updates.
points: Separates school, agency, and teacher workflows instead of flattening them into one admin view.
Uses live status updates so bookings can move without manual chasing.
Designed around operational clarity: who has the request, what changed, and what happens next.
quicksupply.note: The demo gives a quick pass through the agency workflow: request view, assignment context, and live booking status.
